verdict.rationale: Galileo shows some batch-style handling of many items: experiments run prompts and code against whole datasets of inputs, and annotation queues group many sessions, traces and spans for structured review. However, nothing in the evidence documents explicit bulk actions such as bulk edit, tag, delete or export across selected items. missing for 10: documented bulk-action capabilities (multi-select edit/tag/delete/export), a bulk API or MCP batch endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
